integrity: The complete 1996 same-model PDF was inspected at the printed three equations, reaction interpretation, limit-cycle parameter sets, and discussion; document-wide searches found no variance, covariance, conditional, invariant-measure, or moment formulation. The complete open 2013 same-model article was inspected at the model, biological interpretation, Hill-feedback discussion, and oscillation results; targeted full-text searches found no variance, covariance, invariant-measure, average, stationary, or conditional theorem. A published Goodwin recurrence result concerning the global Hopf-slope balance was compared at statement and implication level and does not cover the accepted variance geometry. The three conditional laws, exact covariance elimination, equilibrium rigidity, and monotone-feedback strictness were independently reconstructed and the coefficient algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes compact invariant support in the nonnegative concentration orthant and positive rate constants.
It gives conditional means and stationary variance geometry, not period, waveform, phase response, invariant density, or limit-cycle stability.
The strict sharpened gap uses strict monotonicity of the Hill repression.
The original 1965 Goodwin source was verified only at year resolution; the structured date uses the earliest checked day-resolved same-model publication.
A concise equivalent conditional-regression observation could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Exact variance cascade and feedback anticovariance gap in the Goodwin oscillator
